notes: No app rail; team credentials with generic auth errors only.
Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

labels.subtitle: Sign in with your team account.

geometry.layout: min-h-screen centered; max-w-[360px] card with logo block

expectedTokenGeometry: Form fields stack with space-y-3 rhythm

r10.keyboardTouch: username, password, and submit are keyboard reachable in tab order
r10.focus: inputs and submit button receive focus
r10.screenReader: labels wired to inputs; error uses ErrorBox when present
r10.reducedMotion: submit loading state does not depend on motion
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: submit shows loading while busy; required fields enforced
r10.zoom: heading and inputs remain present at component level
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: card uses px-6 page gutter; max width capped at 360px
